# Casbin Authorization Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.casbin-service` |
| Source | `09_docker/casbin-service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, auth |

Local Casbin authorization service built from the bundled FastAPI app. Provides a
minimal HTTP surface for policy enforcement decisions in the content graph stack.
